comment: Normative test vectors for the .mdstn container format (version byte 0x03). Every vectors entry decrypts to its plaintext; every negative entry fails with its expect class. Generated by go test -run TestGenerateVectors

negative.description: password stream cut after frame 2 of 4, with a new terminator: frame 2 was sealed as non-final
negative.name: truncated-at-boundary

negative.description: password stream with frame 1 repeated after the final frame 3
negative.name: frame-after-final

negative.description: password stream: a full non-final frame, then an authentic empty final frame (a second encoding of 65536 bytes)
negative.name: empty-final-frame

negative.description: two recipient blocks wrap different CEKs; the header MAC uses block 1's CEK and the body opens under both payload keys; recipient 2 unwraps block 2 and fails the header MAC
negative.name: two-cek
negative.recovery_phrase: absurd avoid scissors anxiety gather lottery category door army half long cage bachelor another expect people blade school educate curtain scrub monitor lady beyond

negative.description: password file whose salt value has "\r\n" inside; MAC and body are valid
negative.name: crlf-in-base64

negative.description: password file whose salt value has non-zero padding bits; MAC and body are valid
negative.name: noncanonical-base64-padding

negative.description: valid password file with version byte 0x01: unsupported version
negative.name: version-0x01

negative.description: valid password file with version byte 0x02: unsupported version
negative.name: version-0x02

negative.description: password stream decrypted with a wrong password: the header MAC fails before the body
negative.name: wrong-password

negative.description: X25519 file for recipient 1, decrypted with recipient 2's key: no block opens
negative.name: not-a-recipient
negative.recovery_phrase: absurd avoid scissors anxiety gather lottery category door army half long cage bachelor another expect people blade school educate curtain scrub monitor lady beyond

negative.description: password file whose original_filename is "../x" (not a safe base name); MAC and body are valid
negative.name: bad-filename

negative.description: password file with an unknown member whose value is NaN (not JSON); MAC and body are valid
negative.name: nan-in-header

negative.description: password file whose original_filename holds U+202E (right-to-left override); MAC and body are valid
negative.name: bidi-filename
